text: You’re thankful to her, and you love her. Help us all you can to find her, and may Heaven reward you!’ She looked at him hastily, and for the first time, as if she were doubtful of what he had said. ‘Will you trust me?’ she asked, in a low voice of astonishment. ‘Full and free!’ said Mr. Peggotty. ‘To speak to her, if I should ever find her; shelter her, if I have any shelter to divide with her; and then, without her knowledge, come to you, and bring you to her?’ she asked hurriedly.
